chat.author: Jaime Jimenez
chat.text: Is OCoAP also for Thread distributed type of scenarios or always GW mediated?

chat.author: Mike Bishop
chat.text: Essentially the Gateway doesn't learn the client IP while handling the message, while the Proxy knows the IP without learning the message payload. It's separation of information; the client has to assume/trust non-collusion. But it enables a server to embody its privacy policy by deliberately never learning information it promises not to retain.
